Class ReceiptRenderer

java.lang.Object
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.ReceiptRenderer
public final class ReceiptRenderer extends Object
Renders a LedgerEvaluation as the ike꞉build-report.md receipt, in the house ws꞉*.md receipt style: a title line, a tool/version/timestamp line, then only the sections that have content.

The receipt reads top-down as "what happened, then what needs you": the work the session did and how long it took, the findings the ledger evaluates, and last the console's warnings folded to one line per distinct message.

    • renderLive

      public static String renderLive(String toolVersion, ZonedDateTime timestamp, BuildActivity.Overview overview, ReceiptRenderer.Console console)
      Renders the receipt of a build still in progress: the work so far and the console so far.

      Findings and the gate verdict are left to the final receipt — comparing a partial build against the ledger's expected counts would report shortfalls that are only a matter of time.

      Parameters:
      toolVersion - the extension version stamped under the title
      timestamp - the time of this update, by which a reader can tell a live receipt from one a killed build left
      overview - what the session has built so far
      console - the console's warnings and errors so far
      Returns:
      the receipt as Markdown
